_about: Stage A map (40 x 40 m) of Plot 01, adapted from docs/world.md section 3. Metres; origin at the canopy-gap centre; +x east, +z south, +y up. Hand-placed features only: trees in the stands are generated from these by src/world/layout.js. See docs/world.md 'Stage A' for why positions differ from the 60 m sketch.

slope._note: ground falls NW -> SE; metres of fall per metre of (x + z)

wall._note: x = x0 + a1 sin(f1 z + p1) + a2 sin(f2 z); collapsed dry-stone ridge between ancient woodland (west) and former pasture (east)

outcrop._note: sandstone step along the west edge; x < edge(z) and z > zStart

stream._note: centre line from the spring, downstream

sett._note: badger sett dug into a bank near the wall

windthrow._note: spruce thrown by the Jan 2018 storm; trunks point NE (yaw: radians, 0 = +x, negative turns toward -z = north)

trails._note: narrow worn trails besides the main deer path: [points], half-width in metres

antMound._note: red wood ant mound at the sunny south edge of the plantation

zones._note: boundaries east of the wall (z, metres); noise-perturbed by about +-1.5 m
